why: Source: four statement checks on a 3x3 growth table (20-year extrapolation comparison, past growth versus rest of market, growth-pace ratio, share four years ago), about 6 steps; question: the same four checks on the same table shape (about 6 steps), with no step type added or dropped.
Source: profit per unit, divide by litres per unit, scale to thousand litres, ignore the distractor variable (4 steps); question: the identical path with tins instead of cups (4 steps).

Source: share per broker for three classes, combined A+C and A+B ratios, four comparisons (about 6 steps); question: the same per-reseller ratios, combined ratios and four comparisons (about 6 steps), with an irrelevant fourth column in both.
Source: two profits, two per-item divisions, percentage change, match option (about 5 steps); question: two profits, two per-ticket divisions, percentage change, match option (about 5 steps).

Source: convert income to dollars by dividing by the rate, then multiply by PPP, choosing the right orientation (2 steps); question: divide pages by yield to get cartridges, then multiply by price (2 steps).

Source: identify the hand-sorted share from the last funnel row (trap), two complement-times-volume calculations, difference (4 steps); question: the identical funnel reading, two products and a difference (4 steps).

Source: locate the country's customers, daily-to-annual profit, divide investment, round up to has-broken-even option (4 steps); question: the same lookup, annualisation, division and round-up (4 steps).

Source: people visiting once times fraction, then divide by visits not people (trap) (2 steps plus trap); question: the same fraction product and division by visits with the same trap (2 steps plus trap).

Source: daily-to-weekly fixed cost, per-customer variable cost from two factors, contribution, break-even division, round up to smallest profitable option (5 steps); question: nightly-to-weekly cost, per-site driving cost, contribution, division, round up (5 steps).

Source: read prices and off-gridline volumes from an unlabelled dual-axis chart, compute margin times volume for four options, compare (about 4 steps); question: the same unlabelled dual-axis reading with off-gridline volumes, four margin-times-volume products and comparison (about 4 steps).
